quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to fill a lunchbox with food for midday"?
quests.question: Pack a Lunch
quests.hint: A lunchbox or paper bag holds the food for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pack a lunch in the morning so we have food ready for midday.
quests.funFact: Packing a colorful lunch with fruits and veggies can make lunchtime extra fun!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to stand in order with your classmates before class starts"?
quests.question: Line Up for Class
quests.hint: You stand behind your classmates, one after another, for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We line up for class to walk inside neatly together.
quests.funFact: Lining up in order helps everyone walk safely and calmly into the classroom!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to make a neat knot so your shoes stay snug"?
quests.question: Tie Shoelaces
quests.hint: Two loops crossed together make the knot for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We tie our shoelaces so our shoes stay snug on our feet.
quests.funFact: Learning to tie your own shoelaces is a proud step toward getting ready all by yourself!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to say farewell with a friendly hand wave"?
quests.question: Wave Goodbye
quests.hint: Your hand moves back and forth for this friendly farewell.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wave goodbye to family before we head off to school.
quests.funFact: Waving goodbye is a friendly gesture used by people all around the world!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to fill your bowl with crunchy flakes and milk"?
quests.question: Pour Cereal
quests.hint: A bowl, a box, and a splash of milk are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pour cereal into a bowl to make a quick, crunchy breakfast.
quests.funFact: Cereal was first made as a quick, healthy breakfast that's easy to prepare!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to place your bag on its hook once you arrive at school"?
quests.question: Hang Up Your Backpack
quests.hint: A hook or a cubby is where this bag ends up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We hang up our backpack once we arrive at school.
quests.funFact: Every student's hook or cubby is a special spot just for their own things!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to hang your bag up neatly after you get to class"?
quests.question: Hang Up Your Backpack
quests.hint: You do this right after you arrive at school, not before you leave home.
quests.explanation: That's right! Hanging up a backpack means placing it neatly on a hook.
quests.funFact: A tidy hook area makes it easy to grab your backpack again after school!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to stand at your stop until the bus arrives"?
quests.question: Wait for the Bus
quests.hint: You stand at a special sign or stop for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wait for the bus at our stop before it arrives.
quests.funFact: Standing back from the curb while you wait helps keep you safe until the bus arrives!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to add crunchy flakes to a bowl for breakfast"?
quests.question: Pour Cereal
quests.hint: This makes a crunchy start to your breakfast.
quests.explanation: That's right! Pouring cereal is a fast way to get breakfast ready.
quests.funFact: Whole grain cereals can give you energy that lasts through your whole morning!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to form a neat row before walking inside together"?
quests.question: Line Up for Class
quests.hint: This happens right before you walk into your classroom together.
quests.explanation: That's right! Lining up means standing in a tidy row before class begins.
quests.funFact: Many classrooms line up the same way every single morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to prepare a meal to eat later at school"?
quests.question: Pack a Lunch
quests.hint: You do this before school, but you eat the food much later.
quests.explanation: That's right! Packing a lunch means choosing food to eat later at school.
quests.funFact: Some children like to pack their own lunch and choose their favorite foods!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to loop and tie your laces before you go outside"?
quests.question: Tie Shoelaces
quests.hint: This keeps your shoes snug so they won't slip off.
quests.explanation: That's right! Tying shoelaces means making a neat knot to keep shoes secure.
quests.funFact: Some sneakers use velcro instead of laces to make getting dressed even faster!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to stand behind your classmates in a tidy line"?
quests.question: Line Up for Class
quests.hint: A neat row, not a crowd, is the goal for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Lining up helps our whole class walk inside safely together.
quests.funFact: Lining up in order helps everyone walk safely and calmly into the classroom!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to look down the road for the bus to appear"?
quests.question: Wait for the Bus
quests.hint: This happens before you climb aboard, not after.
quests.explanation: That's right! Waiting for the bus means standing patiently until it comes.
quests.funFact: Bus stops often have a sign so everyone knows exactly where to wait!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to give a cheerful wave before heading off to school"?
quests.question: Wave Goodbye
quests.hint: You do this right before you leave for school.
quests.explanation: That's right! Waving goodbye is a friendly way to say farewell.
quests.funFact: A cheerful goodbye can help everyone feel happy as the day begins!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to choose food to bring along for lunchtime"?
quests.question: Pack a Lunch
quests.hint: Sandwiches, fruit, or crackers might go inside for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! A packed lunch means you're ready for a tasty midday meal.
quests.funFact: Packing a colorful lunch with fruits and veggies can make lunchtime extra fun!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to send a friendly goodbye as you leave the house"?
quests.question: Wave Goodbye
quests.hint: A smile often comes along with this friendly gesture.
quests.explanation: Well done! A cheerful wave is a warm way to start the school day.
quests.funFact: Waving goodbye is a friendly gesture used by people all around the world!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to store your bag on a hook before class begins"?
quests.question: Hang Up Your Backpack
quests.hint: This keeps your bag safe and out of the way during class.
quests.explanation: Well done! A backpack on its hook keeps our classroom tidy.
quests.funFact: Every student's hook or cubby is a special spot just for their own things!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to make a quick, crunchy breakfast in a bowl"?
quests.question: Pour Cereal
quests.hint: You do this before you sit down to eat breakfast.
quests.explanation: Well done! A bowl of cereal with milk makes a tasty morning meal.
quests.funFact: Cereal was first made as a quick, healthy breakfast that's easy to prepare!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to stand patiently at your spot before school"?
quests.question: Wait for the Bus
quests.hint: You need a little patience while you do this.
quests.explanation: Well done! A little patience helps us wait safely for the bus.
quests.funFact: Standing back from the curb while you wait helps keep you safe until the bus arrives!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to secure your shoes with a careful knot"?
quests.question: Tie Shoelaces
quests.hint: You do this right after your shoes go on your feet.
quests.explanation: Well done! A good knot keeps your shoes on tight while you run and play.
quests.funFact: Learning to tie your own shoelaces is a proud step toward getting ready all by yourself!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to fill a bowl before adding a splash of milk"?
quests.question: Pour Cereal
quests.hint: A bowl, a box, and a splash of milk are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pour cereal into a bowl to make a quick, crunchy breakfast.
quests.funFact: Whole grain cereals can give you energy that lasts through your whole morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to have a little bite to keep your energy up"?
quests.question: Eat a Snack
quests.hint: Fruit, crackers, or cheese are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! A snack is a small, tasty bite between meals.
quests.funFact: A small snack can help keep your tummy happy until dinner time!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to turn the pages of a favorite story"?
quests.question: Read a Book
quests.hint: You might do this snuggled up with a favorite stuffed animal.
quests.explanation: Well done! A good book can help us feel calm and sleepy before bed.
quests.funFact: Some children love hearing the very same favorite story again and again!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to put your bag away neatly right when you arrive"?
quests.question: Hang Up Your Backpack
quests.hint: A hook or a cubby is where this bag ends up.
quests.explanation: Yes! We hang up our backpack once we arrive at school.
quests.funFact: A tidy hook area makes it easy to grab your backpack again after school!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to wait your turn in a row before entering class"?
quests.question: Line Up for Class
quests.hint: You stand behind your classmates, one after another, for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We line up for class to walk inside neatly together.
quests.funFact: Many classrooms line up the same way every single morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to give indoor plants a drink before they get thirsty"?
quests.question: Water the Plants
quests.hint: Plants need this to stay green and grow strong.
quests.explanation: That's right! Watering plants means giving them a drink so they can grow.
quests.funFact: Plants use water and sunlight together to make their own food and grow!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to wave farewell to family before your day begins"?
quests.question: Wave Goodbye
quests.hint: Your hand moves back and forth for this friendly farewell.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wave goodbye to family before we head off to school.
quests.funFact: A cheerful goodbye can help everyone feel happy as the day begins!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to watch for the bus to come around the corner"?
quests.question: Wait for the Bus
quests.hint: You stand at a special sign or stop for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wait for the bus at our stop before it arrives.
quests.funFact: Bus stops often have a sign so everyone knows exactly where to wait!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to get strong energy for learning and play"?
quests.question: Eat Breakfast
quests.hint: You do this before you leave for school.
quests.explanation: Well done! A good breakfast helps us focus and play all morning.
quests.funFact: Breakfast is often called the most important meal because it fuels your whole morning!
